0.original: Alphinaud would enlist your aid in checking on the injured Yok Huy.

24.original: Speak with injured Yok Huy in Worlar's Echo.

48.original: Stay with me! We'll have a healer see to you soon!

49.original: There, that should help. Rest awhile, and you'll be back on your feet in no time.

50.original: This is a Sharlayan restorative potion. Drink it slowly.

51.original: You'll be fine. Just try to avoid sudden movements so you don't reopen your wounds.

52.original: Urianger says fire aether pervades the entire village. What happened here...?

53.original: Many of the villagers sustained burns, but the fire found no purchase in these stone buildings. A small mercy.

54.original: Though Valigarmanda's escape is of dire concern, we must needs tend to those caught in the conflagration.

55.original: If you are ready, there are many injured here who need aid. Should you find anyone passed out from their wounds, I ask that you alert me to them.

56.original: Otherwise, I shall be tending to whomever requires the most urgent healing. We can gather here once we've seen to these people's hurts.

57.original: Once we've treated the wounded, I'll have everyone meet at the spot where we were talking earlier.

61.original: Everything was bathed in bright red. A searing heat enveloped my entire body. I couldn't move...

67.original: Everything burns... The touch of cloth is agony. Yet I will live. Leave me─there are others in more dire need of help.

69.original: We are fortunate indeed that you and your companions have come.

73.original: My wounds are nothing serious, but this dryness in my throat... It's as if all the moisture has left my body.

75.original: That strangers from across the salt should be the ones to aid us...

76.original: I've done all I can for now. The injured you found were awake and alert, then?

78.original: We've left the injured as comfortable as we could.

79.original: Many were suffering from burns to a greater or lesser degree. Did a fire sweep through the village?

81.original: Once I'd healed the giant attacked by that mountain bird, the group's leader─Vorporlor, I believe they called him─bade me depart. It was then that I felt an intense wave of aether, and returned to find Worlar's Echo in this state.

83.original: I rushed over to the first giant I saw. Though delirious with pain, he repeated the same warning: Valigarmanda had broken free. Thus did I contact you with all haste.

84.original: Well, we're going to need more information than that before we can deal with the situation.

85.original: Yes, we should speak with the temple guard, and see what's become of the Skyruin's prison!

86.original: We need to find out exactly what's going on!

87.original: They did say the prison was beginning to fail, but I felt certain it would hold for another few years, at least. Was I mistaken?

88.original: The High Luminary will have returned by now. Hopefully he's found out more than we have...

89.original: I would be glad to learn that this was all some misunderstanding... A futile hope, by the looks of things.

90.original: Whatever answers exist await us inside the temple.

91.original: The High Luminary grants you entry, and awaits you within.

92.original: Two casters releasing spells of fire at the exact same moment... A feat impossible for any but a two-headed Mamool Ja.

93.original: When I said I would take on the duties of a guide, that did not include the tracking of ancient and terrible tural vidraal. Still, we can't leave Valigarmanda free to ravage the land.

94.original: Should a claimant reckless enough to free the Skyruin become Dawnservant, what would become of Tuliyollal?

95.original: That fiend Bakool Ja Ja─he's rotten through and through! There's nothing “blessed” about him!

96.original: So, Erenville. Any ideas on how we can track Valigarmanda?

97.original: The tried-and-true method of comparing sightings with other signs of passage is the most reliable. But also the most time-consuming.

98.original: There is a second option... Not as reliable as the first, but if we're lucky, it will let us ascertain the Skyruin's whereabouts far more quickly.

99.original: Though a tural vidraal of extraordinary nature, Valigarmanda is still a creature of this world.

100.original: Like you and me, it is thus sustained by corporeal energy and possesses a unique aetherial balance. Which means this device should come in <hex:021A020203>handy<hex:021A020103>.

101.original: A floating hand!? Now's not the time to be playing with toys!

102.original: This is no toy─it's an aether seeker. As the name suggests, gleaners use it to detect the aether of living beings.

103.original: And you've had that in your pack this whole time...?

104.original: I can calibrate it to follow a specific aetherial aspect. The problem with Valigarmanda, however, is that it can shift freely between the elements of fire, ice, or lightning...

105.original: Well, we know that in order to awaken Valigarmanda from its icy imprisonment, Bakool Ja Ja cast spells which quickened its fire-aspected aether.

106.original: And the residents here were uniformly afflicted by burns.

107.original: Therefore the logical conclusion is that, upon breaking free, Valigarmanda unleashed a great fiery blast.

108.original: Then the choice is plain. Fire.

109.original: The seeker, however, is not without its faults. As we were not able to input our quarry's unique aetheric signature in advance, the device will respond to <hex:021A020203>any<hex:021A020103> living source of fire-aspected aether.

110.original: So, we have the reliable─yet slow─method of information gathering, versus the potentially swift─but easily misled─gleaner tool. I say why not pursue both methods at the same time?

111.original: Good idea! We'll have the first to fall back on if the second fails!

112.original: You travel with me, then, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. In case the seeker leads me to some other fiery fiend.

113.original: The rest of us can stay behind and talk to eyewitnesses. The more Skyruin sightings we can compare, the more accurate our information will be.

114.original: If no one has any objections, I shall remain here in the village and tend to the Yok Huy.

115.original: Very few are seriously injured, but I am wary of wounds inflicted by a creature like Valigarmanda. I should like to be close at hand should their condition suddenly worsen.

116.original: Right, it sounds like we all have work to do!

117.original: We should be on our way as well.
